tasks.commitBody:
Events are now entered and edited as start/end date+time instead
of a duration field: the create form gets an end date (native
input) and end time (TimeSelect, honoring the AM/PM preference),
and the detail page's duration field becomes an editable end in
the whole-field idiom. Under the hood nothing changed on the wire
— duration_minutes is computed from the two endpoints, each
converted independently to a UTC instant via the existing two-pass
Tallinn helper, so a camp spanning a DST shift stores its true
elapsed minutes (25-hour day fixtures pinned by test). v4E event
keeps start_datetime + duration_minutes; no schema change (settled
on the issue — do not re-open).

Series-create per-occurrence duration and the convert flow are
deliberately out of scope per the issue.
